Definition: probably to leap (with joy), i.e. exult
BiblicalUsage: çâlad means to leap with joy, to exult. It appears once, in Job among them, and that use is enough to fix its sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çâlad, little-used as it is, earns its place in Scripture.
